about: Minto is a town in Wellington County, Ontario, made up of Harriston, Palmerston, and Clifford—not Minto in Manitoba, and not a single urban core. Farm-service main streets, rail heritage, and the Maitland River headwaters define this rural town. About 9,000 people live in Minto.
seoSummary: Wellington County town of Harriston, Palmerston, and Clifford—farm-service communities, not Minto, Manitoba.
